answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened at Nazareth: the angel sent to Mary, Jesus dwelling there as a child, and Jesus reading in the synagogue.

clauses.english: was where the angel Gabriel was sent to the virgin Mary
clauses.quote: the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee

clauses.english: was where Jesus dwelt as a child
clauses.quote: he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth

clauses.english: was where Jesus went into the synagogue on the sabbath and stood up to read
clauses.quote: he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read

doubts: MAT 13:54 and MRK 6:1 speak of Jesus' "own country" without naming Nazareth, so I left them out.
Verses that only call Jesus "of Nazareth" (as a title or label) were not used as events of the place.
LUK 2:43 (Jesus tarrying in Jerusalem) is marked but concerns Jerusalem, not Nazareth.
